newTopics.title: Color Basics: The Wheel, Warm & Cool, and Complementary Pairs
newTopics.summary: How colors relate to each other, and how artists use warm, cool and opposite colors to create mood and make things glow.
newTopics.tryIt: Paint the same small scene twice — once using only warm colors, once using only cool colors. Which one feels calmer? Which one feels warmer in temperature?

newTopics.title: Seurat & Pointillism: Mixing Color with Dots
newTopics.summary: Seurat placed tiny dots of pure color side by side and let the viewer's eye mix them — a scientific way of making paintings shimmer.
newTopics.tryIt: Fill a small square with dots of only blue and yellow. Step back across the room — what color do you see now?
